tools.name: wordtune
tools.description: Wordtune is an AI-powered writing assistant designed to help users refine, rewrite, and enhance their text for clarity, conciseness, and improved readability. Unlike traditional grammar checkers, Wordtune focuses on rephrasing sentences with better tone, flow, and engagement, making it ideal for professional, academic, and everyday writing.

tools.name: Odia Gen AI
tools.description: OdiaGenAI is a collaborative open-source initiative launched in 2023 to develop generative AI and LLM technologies tailored for Odia—a low-resource Indic language—and other regional languages. Led by Odia technologists and hosted under Odisha AI, it focuses on building pretrained, fine-tuned, and instruction-following models, datasets, and tools to empower areas like education, governance, agriculture, tourism, health, and industry.

tools.name: Memedesk
tools.description: MemeDeck is an innovative platform designed to turn communities into viral content creators. By leveraging AI-powered meme creation, MemeDeck allows users to generate engaging and shareable memes, particularly for crypto projects. It aims to amplify the reach and impact of memes within the digital ecosystem, making it easier for communities to participate in the memecoin revolution.

tools.name: Meta Llama 3.2
tools.description: Llama 3.2 is Meta’s multimodal and lightweight update to its Llama 3 line, released on September 25, 2024. The family includes 1B and 3B text-only models optimized for edge devices, as well as 11B and 90B Vision models capable of image understanding. It offers a 128K-token context window, Grouped-Query Attention for efficient inference, and opens up on-device, private AI with strong multilingual (e.g. Hindi, Spanish) support.

tools.name: Meta Llama 3.3
tools.description: Llama 3.3 is Meta’s instruction-tuned, text-only large language model released on December 6, 2024, available in a 70B-parameter size. It matches the performance of much larger models using significantly fewer parameters, is multilingual across eight key languages, and supports a massive 128,000-token context window—ideal for handling long-form documents, codebases, and detailed reasoning tasks.

tools.name: Semrush - Content Shake AI
tools.description: ContentShake AI is an intelligent writing tool developed by Semrush, designed to streamline the content creation process for small teams and individual creators. By integrating advanced AI capabilities with Semrush's robust SEO data, ContentShake AI enables users to generate high-quality, SEO-optimized content efficiently. The platform offers features such as data-driven topic suggestions, brand voice customization, and seamless publishing options, making it a comprehensive solution for content marketing needs.

tools.name: Speechify
tools.description: Speechify.com is a leading AI-powered text-to-speech (TTS) reader designed to transform any written text into natural-sounding audio. With millions of users and high ratings, it aims to help individuals consume content faster and more efficiently across various devices and platforms. Beyond basic text-to-speech, Speechify also offers advanced AI features for content creators, including AI voice generation, voice cloning, and dubbing.

tools.name: Natural Reader
tools.description: NaturalReaders.com is an advanced AI-powered text-to-speech (TTS) software that transforms various types of text, including documents, PDFs, and web pages, into natural-sounding spoken audio. Its primary purpose is to enhance productivity, accessibility, and learning by allowing users to listen to content on the go, proofread their writing, and overcome reading difficulties.

tools.name: Oyeeah
tools.description: Oyeeah is a versatile platform offering a comprehensive suite of AI tools designed to enhance productivity and drive innovation. It provides cutting-edge solutions for automation, data analysis, content creation, and more, all integrated into a single platform. Whether you're looking to automate tasks, analyze data, or create compelling content, Oyeeah offers the tools to streamline your workflow and achieve your goals efficiently.

tools.name: WriteHuman
tools.description: WriteHuman is an AI-powered tool designed to humanize AI-generated text, making it undetectable by AI detection tools like GPTZero, Turnitin, and Originality.ai. It ensures AI-assisted content maintains a natural, human-like tone while preserving readability and coherence.

tools.name: Course Hero
tools.description: CourseHero.com is an online learning platform and document-sharing website designed to help students and educators access course-specific study resources and connect with online tutors. Founded in 2006, it provides a vast library of user-submitted and educator-created content, including study guides, class notes, practice problems, and textbook solutions. Its purpose is to help students feel confident and prepared from day one to graduation by offering readily available study aids and homework support.

tools.name: SeekhoAI
tools.description: Seekho AI is an innovative AI-powered podcast generator that allows users to convert virtually any type of content—including YouTube videos, research papers, PDFs, articles, and plain text—into high-quality, engaging audio lessons within seconds. Designed with learners, professionals, and content consumers in mind, Seekho AI helps transform passive reading into active listening, making it easier to absorb knowledge on the go. Whether you're looking to catch up on complex research, summarize a long-form article, or turn a video lecture into a podcast-style episode, Seekho AI offers a seamless and intuitive experience. The platform is currently available on iOS and iPadOS devices and supports more than 10 languages, including English, Hindi, Spanish, French, and German. Users can also choose from various podcast tones and lengths, tailoring each audio lesson to their learning preferences.

tools.name: OpenAI Dall-E 2
tools.description:
DALL·E 2 is an AI model developed by OpenAI that generates images from text descriptions (prompts). It improves upon its predecessor, DALL·E 1, by producing higher-resolution, more realistic, and creative images based on user input.
The model can also edit existing images, expand images beyond their original borders (inpainting), and create artistic interpretations of text descriptions.
 Note: OpenAI has phased out DALL·E 2 in favor of DALL·E 3, which offers more advanced image generation.

tools.name: Compose AI
tools.description: Compose AI is a free Chrome extension that leverages artificial intelligence to enhance writing efficiency. It offers features like AI-powered autocomplete, text generation, and sentence rephrasing, aiming to reduce typing time and streamline the writing process.

tools.name: aiundetect
tools.description: AI Undetect is an AI-powered tool designed to make AI-generated content appear more human-like. It modifies text to bypass AI detection tools such as Turnitin, GPTZero, and Originality.ai, making it useful for content creators, students, and professionals who need AI-assisted content that reads naturally.

tools.name: Rewritify
tools.description: Rewritify is an AI-powered rewriting tool designed to enhance and modify content while maintaining its original meaning. It helps users improve clarity, readability, and uniqueness by restructuring sentences, refining tone, and optimizing text for various purposes, including SEO, content creation, and academic writing.

tools.name: StealthWriter
tools.description: Stealth Writer is an AI-powered content rewriting tool designed to make AI-generated text appear human-written. It helps users bypass AI detection tools while maintaining readability, coherence, and originality. The tool is particularly useful for writers, marketers, and professionals who want to refine AI-assisted content for authenticity and undetectability.

tools.name: StealthGPT
tools.description: StealthGPT is an AI-driven tool designed to generate undetectable AI-written content. It helps users create text that bypasses AI detection tools like GPTZero, Turnitin, and Originality.ai while maintaining natural readability and coherence. It is especially useful for content creators, marketers, and students who want AI assistance without detection risks.

tools.name: Vidu AI
tools.description: Vidu AI is a powerful, web-based AI video creation platform that transforms text prompts, static images, or multiple visual references into high-quality, cinematic videos within seconds. It supports text-to-video, image-to-video, and reference-to-video modes—offering creative flexibility for stylized, realistic, and anime-style content

tools.name: GenColor AI
tools.description: GenColor.ai is a free, web-based AI tool that converts your photos or text prompts into clean, printable coloring pages. Designed for art enthusiasts of all ages, it supports both photo-to-line-art conversions and imaginative scene generation from text—all without requiring signup or payment.

tools.name: Hemingway
tools.description: Hemingway is an AI-powered writing assistant designed to enhance the readability and clarity of written content. It helps users by identifying and highlighting complex sentences, instances of passive voice, overuse of adverbs, and other stylistic elements that can hinder readability. It's used by writers, students, professionals, and content creators to produce text that is concise, impactful, and engaging.

tools.name: OpenAI Deep Research
tools.description: Deep Research is an AI-powered agent that autonomously browses the web, interprets and analyzes text, images, and PDFs, and generates comprehensive, cited reports on user-specified topics. It leverages OpenAI's advanced o3 model to conduct multi-step research tasks, delivering results within 5 to 30 minutes.

tools.name: OpenAI GPT-4o
tools.description: GPT-4o is OpenAI’s latest and most advanced AI model, offering faster, more powerful, and cost-efficient natural language processing. It can handle text, vision, and audio in real time, making it the first OpenAI model to process multimodal inputs natively. It’s significantly faster and cheaper than GPT-4 Turbo while improving accuracy, reasoning, and multilingual support.

tools.name: Typepilot
tools.description: Typepilot.app is a simple, fun, and addictive tool designed for Android devices. It offers a range of features to enhance typing efficiency and accuracy, making it easier to input frequently used text snippets, phrases, sentences, or entire form letters. With Typepilot, users can define keywords that automatically insert predefined text, saving time and reducing errors.

tools.name: OpenAI Sora
tools.description: OpenAI Sora is an AI-powered video generation model that creates high-quality videos from text prompts. It can generate realistic and animated scenes, making it a powerful tool for content creators, filmmakers, marketers, and game developers. Sora excels at understanding complex prompts and maintaining coherent motion, lighting, and detail across frames.

tools.name: Media.io AI Video Generator
tools.description: Media.io AI Video Generator is an online, AI-powered platform that converts text prompts and static images into engaging, high-quality videos. It combines text-to-video and image-to-video capabilities along with built-in editing tools such as subtitles, voiceovers, music integration, and dynamic effects. Its intuitive web interface makes professional-grade video creation accessible to all users

tools.name: MyDetector
tools.description: MyDetector.ai is a free and easy-to-use AI detector that utilizes advanced algorithms to analyze text and determine whether it was written by a human or an AI. It offers high-precision detection, supports various document formats, provides real-time results, and highlights AI-generated parts, making it a valuable tool for verifying text authenticity and optimizing content for a more natural, human-like tone.

tools.name: Google Keep
tools.description: Google Keep is a lightweight note-taking and list-making app from Google, launched in March 2013. It supports text, voice, images, checklists, reminders (time‑ or location-based), and OCR for extracting text from photos. Now part of Google Workspace, it offers real-time collaboration and seamless integration with Docs and other services.

tools.name: Veo 2
tools.description: Veo 2 is Google DeepMind’s advanced text-to-video generator that creates high-quality, cinematic video clips from text or image prompts. It offers realistic human motion, physics consistency, cinematic camera controls, 720p-4K resolution, extended clip length, and an invisible SynthID watermark to identify AI-generated content .

tools.name: Vidboard
tools.description: VidBoard.ai is an AI-powered video creation platform that transforms documents, URLs, or text into engaging, studio-quality videos with lifelike AI avatars or faceless styles. It offers over 100 avatars, 125+ languages, AI script generation, voice cloning, captions, and multimedia assets—enabling users to produce professional videos in minutes without editing experience.

tools.description: Llama 3.2 is Meta’s multimodal and lightweight update to its Llama 3 line, released on September 25, 2024. The family includes 1B and 3B text-only models optimized for edge devices, as well as 11B and 90B Vision models capable of image understanding. It offers a 128K-token context window, Grouped-Query Attention for efficient inference, and opens up on-device, private AI with strong multilingual (e.g. Hindi, Spanish) support.

tools.name: Meta Llama 3.3
tools.description: Llama 3.3 is Meta’s instruction-tuned, text-only large language model released on December 6, 2024, available in a 70B-parameter size. It matches the performance of much larger models using significantly fewer parameters, is multilingual across eight key languages, and supports a massive 128,000-token context window—ideal for handling long-form documents, codebases, and detailed reasoning tasks.

tools.name: Semrush - Content Shake AI
tools.description: ContentShake AI is an intelligent writing tool developed by Semrush, designed to streamline the content creation process for small teams and individual creators. By integrating advanced AI capabilities with Semrush's robust SEO data, ContentShake AI enables users to generate high-quality, SEO-optimized content efficiently. The platform offers features such as data-driven topic suggestions, brand voice customization, and seamless publishing options, making it a comprehensive solution for content marketing needs.

tools.name: Speechify
tools.description: Speechify.com is a leading AI-powered text-to-speech (TTS) reader designed to transform any written text into natural-sounding audio. With millions of users and high ratings, it aims to help individuals consume content faster and more efficiently across various devices and platforms. Beyond basic text-to-speech, Speechify also offers advanced AI features for content creators, including AI voice generation, voice cloning, and dubbing.

tools.name: Natural Reader
tools.description: NaturalReaders.com is an advanced AI-powered text-to-speech (TTS) software that transforms various types of text, including documents, PDFs, and web pages, into natural-sounding spoken audio. Its primary purpose is to enhance productivity, accessibility, and learning by allowing users to listen to content on the go, proofread their writing, and overcome reading difficulties.

tools.name: Oyeeah
tools.description: Oyeeah is a versatile platform offering a comprehensive suite of AI tools designed to enhance productivity and drive innovation. It provides cutting-edge solutions for automation, data analysis, content creation, and more, all integrated into a single platform. Whether you're looking to automate tasks, analyze data, or create compelling content, Oyeeah offers the tools to streamline your workflow and achieve your goals efficiently.

tools.name: WriteHuman
tools.description: WriteHuman is an AI-powered tool designed to humanize AI-generated text, making it undetectable by AI detection tools like GPTZero, Turnitin, and Originality.ai. It ensures AI-assisted content maintains a natural, human-like tone while preserving readability and coherence.

tools.name: Course Hero
tools.description: CourseHero.com is an online learning platform and document-sharing website designed to help students and educators access course-specific study resources and connect with online tutors. Founded in 2006, it provides a vast library of user-submitted and educator-created content, including study guides, class notes, practice problems, and textbook solutions. Its purpose is to help students feel confident and prepared from day one to graduation by offering readily available study aids and homework support.

tools.name: SeekhoAI
tools.description: Seekho AI is an innovative AI-powered podcast generator that allows users to convert virtually any type of content—including YouTube videos, research papers, PDFs, articles, and plain text—into high-quality, engaging audio lessons within seconds. Designed with learners, professionals, and content consumers in mind, Seekho AI helps transform passive reading into active listening, making it easier to absorb knowledge on the go. Whether you're looking to catch up on complex research, summarize a long-form article, or turn a video lecture into a podcast-style episode, Seekho AI offers a seamless and intuitive experience. The platform is currently available on iOS and iPadOS devices and supports more than 10 languages, including English, Hindi, Spanish, French, and German. Users can also choose from various podcast tones and lengths, tailoring each audio lesson to their learning preferences.

tools.name: OpenAI Dall-E 2
tools.description:
DALL·E 2 is an AI model developed by OpenAI that generates images from text descriptions (prompts). It improves upon its predecessor, DALL·E 1, by producing higher-resolution, more realistic, and creative images based on user input.
The model can also edit existing images, expand images beyond their original borders (inpainting), and create artistic interpretations of text descriptions.
 Note: OpenAI has phased out DALL·E 2 in favor of DALL·E 3, which offers more advanced image generation.

tools.name: Compose AI
tools.description: Compose AI is a free Chrome extension that leverages artificial intelligence to enhance writing efficiency. It offers features like AI-powered autocomplete, text generation, and sentence rephrasing, aiming to reduce typing time and streamline the writing process.

tools.name: aiundetect
tools.description: AI Undetect is an AI-powered tool designed to make AI-generated content appear more human-like. It modifies text to bypass AI detection tools such as Turnitin, GPTZero, and Originality.ai, making it useful for content creators, students, and professionals who need AI-assisted content that reads naturally.

tools.name: Rewritify
tools.description: Rewritify is an AI-powered rewriting tool designed to enhance and modify content while maintaining its original meaning. It helps users improve clarity, readability, and uniqueness by restructuring sentences, refining tone, and optimizing text for various purposes, including SEO, content creation, and academic writing.

tools.name: StealthWriter
tools.description: Stealth Writer is an AI-powered content rewriting tool designed to make AI-generated text appear human-written. It helps users bypass AI detection tools while maintaining readability, coherence, and originality. The tool is particularly useful for writers, marketers, and professionals who want to refine AI-assisted content for authenticity and undetectability.

tools.name: StealthGPT
tools.description: StealthGPT is an AI-driven tool designed to generate undetectable AI-written content. It helps users create text that bypasses AI detection tools like GPTZero, Turnitin, and Originality.ai while maintaining natural readability and coherence. It is especially useful for content creators, marketers, and students who want AI assistance without detection risks.

tools.name: Vidu AI
tools.description: Vidu AI is a powerful, web-based AI video creation platform that transforms text prompts, static images, or multiple visual references into high-quality, cinematic videos within seconds. It supports text-to-video, image-to-video, and reference-to-video modes—offering creative flexibility for stylized, realistic, and anime-style content

tools.name: GenColor AI
tools.description: GenColor.ai is a free, web-based AI tool that converts your photos or text prompts into clean, printable coloring pages. Designed for art enthusiasts of all ages, it supports both photo-to-line-art conversions and imaginative scene generation from text—all without requiring signup or payment.

tools.name: Hemingway
tools.description: Hemingway is an AI-powered writing assistant designed to enhance the readability and clarity of written content. It helps users by identifying and highlighting complex sentences, instances of passive voice, overuse of adverbs, and other stylistic elements that can hinder readability. It's used by writers, students, professionals, and content creators to produce text that is concise, impactful, and engaging.

tools.name: OpenAI Deep Research
tools.description: Deep Research is an AI-powered agent that autonomously browses the web, interprets and analyzes text, images, and PDFs, and generates comprehensive, cited reports on user-specified topics. It leverages OpenAI's advanced o3 model to conduct multi-step research tasks, delivering results within 5 to 30 minutes.

tools.name: OpenAI GPT-4o
tools.description: GPT-4o is OpenAI’s latest and most advanced AI model, offering faster, more powerful, and cost-efficient natural language processing. It can handle text, vision, and audio in real time, making it the first OpenAI model to process multimodal inputs natively. It’s significantly faster and cheaper than GPT-4 Turbo while improving accuracy, reasoning, and multilingual support.

tools.name: Typepilot
tools.description: Typepilot.app is a simple, fun, and addictive tool designed for Android devices. It offers a range of features to enhance typing efficiency and accuracy, making it easier to input frequently used text snippets, phrases, sentences, or entire form letters. With Typepilot, users can define keywords that automatically insert predefined text, saving time and reducing errors.

tools.name: OpenAI Sora
tools.description: OpenAI Sora is an AI-powered video generation model that creates high-quality videos from text prompts. It can generate realistic and animated scenes, making it a powerful tool for content creators, filmmakers, marketers, and game developers. Sora excels at understanding complex prompts and maintaining coherent motion, lighting, and detail across frames.

tools.name: Media.io AI Video Generator
tools.description: Media.io AI Video Generator is an online, AI-powered platform that converts text prompts and static images into engaging, high-quality videos. It combines text-to-video and image-to-video capabilities along with built-in editing tools such as subtitles, voiceovers, music integration, and dynamic effects. Its intuitive web interface makes professional-grade video creation accessible to all users

tools.name: MyDetector
tools.description: MyDetector.ai is a free and easy-to-use AI detector that utilizes advanced algorithms to analyze text and determine whether it was written by a human or an AI. It offers high-precision detection, supports various document formats, provides real-time results, and highlights AI-generated parts, making it a valuable tool for verifying text authenticity and optimizing content for a more natural, human-like tone.

tools.name: Google Keep
tools.description: Google Keep is a lightweight note-taking and list-making app from Google, launched in March 2013. It supports text, voice, images, checklists, reminders (time‑ or location-based), and OCR for extracting text from photos. Now part of Google Workspace, it offers real-time collaboration and seamless integration with Docs and other services.

tools.name: Veo 2
tools.description: Veo 2 is Google DeepMind’s advanced text-to-video generator that creates high-quality, cinematic video clips from text or image prompts. It offers realistic human motion, physics consistency, cinematic camera controls, 720p-4K resolution, extended clip length, and an invisible SynthID watermark to identify AI-generated content .

tools.name: Vidboard
tools.description: VidBoard.ai is an AI-powered video creation platform that transforms documents, URLs, or text into engaging, studio-quality videos with lifelike AI avatars or faceless styles. It offers over 100 avatars, 125+ languages, AI script generation, voice cloning, captions, and multimedia assets—enabling users to produce professional videos in minutes without editing experience.
